properties.name: FIELD REPORT (bhome S3, 2026-09-18, partner side): CairoSVG was installed into the running IFC server's environment and ifc_plot failed identically afterwards, because the server imported once at startup — 'a dependency installed under a live MCP server does not exist until the server restarts, and nothing in the error says so'. The same class as reflow2's own ninth release-cut step: a running server keeps the image it started from
properties.source: bhome feedback.md, Session 3 (2026-09-18), triaged 2026-09-19 through the triage-feedback skill
properties.statement: Not reflow2's defect; recorded because it is the third instance of the class in a week (the release binary, the shared daemon, now a partner's interpreter) and the lesson generalises: after installing or rebuilding anything a live server loaded, restart it, and a reconnect is not a restart.
